Footer.about: Ritinari Karya Indonesia is a traditional cultural dance studio dedicated to preserving and introducing the rich cultural heritage of Indonesia through dance.

hero.subtitle: Preserving ancestral heritage through every harmonious, graceful, and soulful movement.

tentang.title: About Ritinari
tentang.subtitle: Our Story and Mission
tentang.p1: Ritinari Karya Indonesia was founded with a vision to become the center of preservation and development of traditional Indonesian dance. We believe that dance is not just physical movement, but a bridge that connects us with ancestral soul and national identity.
tentang.p2: With professional and experienced instructors, we offer an immersive learning environment for all ages to get to know and love the culture of Nusantara.

service1.title: Traditional Dance Class
service1.desc: Intensive learning of various regional dances of the Archipelago (Java, Bali, Sumatra, etc) for beginners to advanced levels.

service2.title: Professional Performance
service2.desc: Provision of professional dance teams for state events, corporate shows, weddings, and national/international cultural festivals.

service3.title: Traditional Costume Rental
service3.desc: A complete collection of high-quality, authentic traditional dance costumes and their matching accessories.

Layanan.title: Detailed Services
Layanan.subtitle: Explore the best services from Ritinari Karya Indonesia

kelas.title: Traditional Dance Class
kelas.desc: We open regular and private classes for children, youth, and adults. The curriculum covers basic techniques, facial expressions (wiraga, wirama, wirasa), and choreography of Nusantara dance.

show.title: Professional Performance
show.desc: Custom choreography tailored to your event theme. We present grand colossal or solo dance performances with modern traditional music arrangements.
features: Flexibility of duration and dance types

sewa.title: Dance & Traditional Costume Rental
sewa.desc: Well-maintained, clean, scented, and complete costumes from various regions in Indonesia. We also provide traditional make-up services.
features: Complete collections from Java, Sunda, Bali, Sumatra, etc
Competitive rental prices with flexible duration
